Sora was summoned to another world as a hero. While other heroes were bestowed with powerful combat skills, Sora’s skill was something ordinary: Alchemy. Ridiculed for having a useless skill, he was exiled to the Demon Forest. However, little did they know, his skill was actually an exceptional SSS-Rank skill!

description.ja:
勇者として異世界に召喚されたソラ。他の転移者が戦闘スキルを授かる中、ソラは外れとされる錬金術のスキルを授かり、役立たずだと即追放されてしまう。着の身着のまま飛ばされたのはSSSランクの魔境でいきなり絶体絶命になってしまい――。

「《鑑定》に《構築》、《合成》・・・？ 全然外れスキルじゃない！」

戦闘に支援、クラフトと錬金術がとんでも万能スキルであることがわかり、SSSランク魔境を無双状態!! ラスボス級の魔物も仲間にして、知らぬ間に魔境を統べる存在になっていて・・・？

description.en:
Arrogant young noble Lofus is furious. You would be, too, if you discovered your role in this world of a popular RPG is that of a petty villain who's destined to be killed off with zero fanfare. It is an ignoble end far below someone of his stature. Though only twelve years old, Lofus is prepared to use every means at his disposal to avoid what fate has in store for him—from rooting out the corruption that incites his end to alleviating the taxes on his people. As he battles the monsters wreaking havoc over his territory, his true power—one absent in the original game—begins to awaken. For whatever reason, the commoners sing his praises, but he insists he's only in it for himself.
___
**Original Web Novel:** [Kakuyomu](https://kakuyomu.jp/works/16817330651994399896), [Syosetu](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n5938ia/)
description.ja: 傲慢貴族・ローファスは、キレていた。なぜなら人気RPGが具現化した異世界で、己が”チンケな悪役貴族”としてパッとしない殺され方をされ続けたからだ。そんな無様な死に方は誇り高き貴族にふさわしくない。まだ12歳だが、年齢なんて関係ない。使えるものはすべて使い、悲惨な破滅エンドを回避するために動き出す！回避のついでに領民の重税を解消し、領地を荒らす魔物を倒し続けたら、ゲームでは発揮されなかった本来の力が目覚め始めて…!?なぜか領民に称賛されるが――「勘違いするな、下民が。俺は俺のためにやっている」

However, because his distances were too long, he was kicked out by his party leader, who didn't understand his work. Then, a former female classmate visits him, saying, "I've come to scout you." She works in the private army of the princess of a neighboring country. Gamma joined the army on her recommendation, and with his incredible range, he takes on important missions one after another, becoming an indispensable member of the army. Meanwhile, his former party, having lost their valuable fighting force, continues to fail quests...

Девушка со шведскими и японскими корнями, у которой, кажется, есть всё, кроме опыта общения противоположным полом, использует приложение для обучения свиданиям, чтобы научиться флиртовать.
Однако парень, с которым у нее завязываются отношения, использует то же приложение с другим тренером!
description.uk:
Ака Акасака, автор "Каґуя-сама хоче, щоб він зізнався їй. Війна сердець та розумів геніїв" та "Дитя улюбленця", презентує свій новий витвір!

У Марі Марії Вінтер-Нанасе, наполовину шведки, наполовину японки, є все, про що можна мріяти. Дівчина виросла в заможній родині закордоном, має багато подруг і вродливу зовнішність. Однак є в ній один недолік: вона не вміє розмовляти з хлопцями!

Узявши в бібліотеці книгу про кохання, у ній вона знайшла підозрілу рекламу. Там йшлося про Агентство Кохання, що надає профі в коханні, який упорається з вашим особистим життям за вас. Після того, як дівчина відсканувала код, з'являється агентка, на ім'я Кон, та обіцяє допомогти Марі зійтися з її коханим. Однак хлопець, що припав їй до душі, Секі Масая, не такий уже й невинний і також користується послугами агентства, щоб почати зустрічатися з нею. Як складеться доля цієї пари?
description.vi: Tác phẩm của Akasaka Aka (tác giả của Oshi no Ko và Kaguya-sama) và Nishizawa 5mm. Một cô gái mang trong mình dòng máu Thụy Điển và Nhật Bản cực kỳ ưu tú nhưng cô ấy lại không có kinh nghiệm với đàn ông. Cô ấy quyết định sử dụng một ứng dụng dịch vụ tình yêu để chinh phục chàng trai ấy. Tuy nhiên, anh chàng mà cô ấy nhắm đến cũng đang sử dụng ứng dụng đó để chinh phục cô!
description.pt-br: Uma garota meio sueca/meio japonesa que parece ter tudo, exceto experiência com homens, está usando um aplicativo de coaching para encontros para se acostumar a flertar. No entanto, o cara com quem ela se dá bem na verdade usa o mesmo aplicativo com um treinador diferente!

Illustrator for Vocaloid's IA and ONE. Aka Akasaka got his start as an assistant to [Jinsei Kataoka](https://mangadex.org/author/7505b97b-e98d-47ce-b13a-24a2e5ba602d/kataoka-jinsei) and [Kazuma Kondou](https://mangadex.org/author/a55909b3-21d7-401a-87bd-1afa51356aa4/kondou-kazuma), the creators of [Deadman Wonderland](https://mangadex.org/title/b96e5e23-0017-4e89-a582-ddaa261bd21d/deadman-wonderland). His first serialized manga was an adaptation of the light novel series [Sayonara Piano Sonata](https://mangadex.org/title/17d4e6e2-5151-4fa0-a29b-8c22ff3f002d/sayonara-piano-sonata), published by Kadokawa in 2011. [Kaguya-sama: Love Is War](https://mangadex.org/title/37f5cce0-8070-4ada-96e5-fa24b1bd4ff9/kaguya-sama-love-is-war) began serialization in Miracle Jump in 2015 but was later moved to Weekly Young Jump in 2016 due to its popularity.

The girl I fell in love with is… an alien!? I, the class president, happened to fall in love with my classmate, the eccentric Haru. I confessed my feelings, but her true identity was an alien who came to Earth to survey it.

description.en:
Akane Nishimura is a shy and gloomy elementary school girl with an unfounded dire reputation in her class due to her appearance. Taiyou Takada is a transfer student in her class who came from a small countryside school, and who is fascinated by the aspects of Nishimura that her classmates use to pick on her, finding her "darkness" cool beyond compare. Through the unbridled and fundamental joy Takada finds in being her friend, Nishimura starts realizing that being herself is not as bad as she thinks.
___
* [Alt English: Comikey](https://comikey.com/comics/my-clueless-first-friend-manga/289/)
description.ja: からかわれてる女の子。クスクス笑うクラスメイト。転校生の高田くんは、そんなクラスの事情は知らない。だからまっすぐ、彼女に届く。
description.uk: Акане Нішімура — сором’язлива та похмура дівчинка початкової школи, яка через свою зовнішність має безпідставну жахливу репутацію у своєму класі. Тайо Такада — новий учень, який перевівся з невеликої сільської школи, і якому подобається унікальність Нішімури, яку її однокласники використовують, щоб познущатися з неї, вважаючи, що її «темрява» виглядає моторошно. Через нестримну та фундаментальну радість, яку проявляє Такада, будучи її другом, Нішімура починає розуміти, що бути собою не так вже й погано, як вона думала.
description.pt-br: Nishimura é uma garota retraída, hostilizada por todos os colegas por seu jeito sombrio, que dizem até que ela é a Morte em pessoa. Mas isso só chama ainda mais a atenção de Takada, um novo aluno transferido. Sem saber o motivo do apelido, que por sinal ele acha super-maneiro, Takada começa a se aproximar mais e mais da Nishimura para se tornar amigo dela. Uma história cativante, cheia de nostalgia dos nossos tempos de fundamental, sobre uma amizade que vai aquecer seus corações!

Plusieurs mois plus tard, alors que ses bourreaux sont aujourd’hui au lycée, ils apprennent qu’elle s’est échappée en tuant tout le personnel hospitalier qui a tenté de lui barrer la route et qu’elle est bien décidé à se venger d’eux.

Grass loses his path in life when he pulls a "flop" during his spirit summoning ceremony. However, he is given another chance when he receives a royal order to fight in the front lines, along with the Princess's knights, as a war doctor. With his "flop" capable of curing anything, the curtains unfold upon a new fantasy war chronicle!  
  


---
description.ru:
Глас теряет волю к жизни во время испытания на призыв духа. Однако ему предоставляется еще один шанс, когда он получает королевский приказ сражаться на передовой вместе с рыцарями принцессы в качестве военного врача. An 'apocalyptic' boy-meets-girl rom-com about high school boy Yutaka Kuromori and the beautiful, popular girl adored by everyone, Aru Hoshina. Yutaka might shyly deny it, insisting "we're not dating," but Aru is always clinging to him, and the two are seen as the talk-of-the-school couple.

But behind what looks like an ordinary boy–girl high school relationship lies a secret — one so ruinous and capricious that, if mishandled, it could bring about the end of the world.

description.pt-br:
Uma comédia romântica apocalíptica sobre Yutaka Kuromori, um garoto do ensino médio, e Aru Hoshina, a linda e popular garota que todos adoram. Embora Yutaka negue envergonhado, dizendo “a gente não tá namorando”, Aru vive grudada nele, e os dois são vistos como o casal do momento na escola.
Mas por trás dessa aparência de romance adolescente comum existe um segredo tão imprevisível e devastador que, se for tratado da maneira errada, pode acabar com o mundo.

Японию начали наводнять таинственные монстры — Аякаси. Ниндзя-экзорцист по имени Мацури неустанно борется с ними изо дня в день, чтобы уберечь себя и свою подругу детства Сузу. Однако, после появления кота-аякаси по имени Широганэ, всё переворачивается с ног на голову!  
Сможет ли наш отважный герой справиться с возникшей напастью? С этого и начинается наше приключение от всеми известного мангаки Кэнтаро Ябуки, который вернулся в Джамп со своей новой фэнтези историей с привкусом романтики!

Desde menino, Matsuri Kazamaki trabalha como exorcista.  Porque seu amigo de infância Suzu Kanade atrai espíritos maliciosos chamados ayakashi como mariposas para uma chama, Matsuri é encarregado de matar qualquer um com más intenções.
  
Um dia, um ayakashi chamado Shirogane percebe o romance entre esses dois amigos de infância.  Ansioso para devorar Suzu e frustrar a chance de amor de Matsuri, ele realiza um feitiço proibido…
  
|| A mais nova série de Kentaro Yabuki, criador de Black Cat e artista por trás de To Love Ru e Darling in the Franxx. ||

biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 矢吹健太朗

**Birthdate:** February 4, 1980

Yabuki Kentarou is a Japanese manga artist, best known for his series *Black Cat* (2000–2004) and for illustrating *To Love Ru* (2006–2009) and *To Love Ru Darkness* (2010–2017) alongside author Saki Hasemi. Currently, Yabuki writes and illustrates the series *Ayakashi Triangle* (2020–present). His mentor was [Takeshi Obata](https://mangadex.org/author/37ffda70-8f9e-4051-a020-073cae8d25a6/obata-takeshi), the illustrator of *Hikaru no Go*, *Death Note* and *Bakuman*.

Yabuki said he was born in Okayama but "formed [his] personality" in Kōchi. In August 2015, Yabuki announced in the September 2015 issue of Jump SQ. that he had gotten married. He is the brother-in-law of fellow manga artist [Kenta Shinohara](https://mangadex.org/author/b362f2ff-85f7-4bed-a0e3-7d3b763f3258/shinohara-kenta).

A young man named Tojuro, who works as an exorcist due to his family's circumstances, dreams of living an ordinary life. However, during one of his missions, he encounters Behemoth, a legendary sacred beast mentioned in ancient legends. But, despite being an "aberrant being," Behemoth does not have the appearance of a monstrous beast; instead, she takes the form of a beautiful woman.

Hace más de diez años, los "seres aberrantes" aparecieron repentinamente en todo el mundo.
Con formas similares a criaturas de diversas leyendas y mitologías, estos "seres aberrantes" llevaron a los países a reunir a sus mejores especialistas para enfrentarlos…
La gente los llamó "exorcistas".

Un joven llamado Tojuro, quien trabaja como exorcista debido a las circunstancias de su familia, sueña con llevar una vida común y corriente.

Pero, a pesar de ser un "ser aberrante", Behemoth no tiene la apariencia de una bestia monstruosa, sino la de una hermosa mujer.

Así comienza la historia de un cazador de criaturas y una autoproclamada "bestia sagrada",

Eines Tages möchte Prinz Christopher Eliana zu seiner Verlobten machen und ihr obendrein freien Zugriff auf die königliche Bibliothek gewähren. Auf Rat ihres Bruders willigt Eliana ein und verschlingt am Hof des Prinzen ein Werk nach dem anderen. Mit ihrem umfangreichen Wissen steht sie vielen Menschen im Palast zur Seite, sodass sie rasch hohes Ansehen genießt. Doch noch ahnt Eliana nicht, dass ihr Leben bald selbst einer Tragödie gleichen wird, wie sie in keinem Buche steht… Band 1 der mitreißenden Fantasy-Lovestory enthält eine entzückende ShoCo Card in der Erstauflage!
description.en: The crown prince Christopher's fiancée (albeit only in name), Elianna, is a noble lady that spends all her time reading books. On one fateful day, Elianna finds out that the prince was apparently being affectionate with a noble lady. Finally, she thought, a girl who actually loves the prince has appeared! With what she thought she had learned in mind, Elianna began to prepare for the inevitable cancellation of her engagement...
description.es: El príncipe heredero, la prometida de Christopher, aunque sólo en nombre, Eliana, es una dama noble que disfruta de su vida leyendo libros todo el día. Un día fatídico, Eliana terminó sabiendo que había una dama noble con la que aparentemente el príncipe era cariñosa. Al instante, pensó que una chica que realmente amaba al príncipe apareció!! Y, mientras pensaba en eso, Eliana comenzó a prepararse para el momento próximo en que se cancelaría su compromiso…
description.fr: Eliana est une noble qui profite de la vie en lisant tous les jours des livres d'où son surnom de «Princesse bibliophilique.» Un jour, le prince hériter Christopher la choisit comme fiancée temporaire. Cependant, quatre années plus tard, Eliana finit par découvrir qu'il y avait une noble dame avec laquelle le prince était très affectueux. Instantanément, elle a cru que le prince avait enfin trouvé le vrai amour! Et c'est avec cette pensée en tête et en ayant le cœur brisé qu'elle commence à se préparer pour la prochaine étape: mettre fin à ses fiançailles!
description.it: Elianna, fidanzata (anche se solo per nome) del principe ereditario Christopher, è una ragazza nobile che trascorre tutto il suo tempo a leggere libri. Un giorno scopre che il principe è affezionato a un'altra nobile fanciulla. "Finalmente", pensa Elianna, "è apparsa una ragazza che ama davvero il principe!". Con questo pensiero in testa, Elianna inizia i preparativi per l'inevitabile annullamento del suo fidanzamento... Una storia romantica fantasy piena di incomprensioni e i conseguenti imbrogli di una ragazza nobile amante dei libri inizia proprio da qui!

Ngay lập tức cô nghĩ rằng đây hẳn là cô gái thực sự yêu vẻ bề ngoài của hoàng tử. Và ngay lúc ấy cô lại bắt đầu chuẩn bị đón nhận cái ngày hôn ước của cô bị hủy bỏ. Cô gái quý tộc yêu sách bắt đầu có những hiểu lầm, câu chuyện lãng mạn và giả tưởng cuối cùng đã bắt đầu.

Instantaneamente, ela pensou a garota por quem o príncipe se apaixonou havia aparecido! E, enquanto pensava nisso, Eliana começou a se preparar para o momento em que seu noivado seria cancelado…

altTitles.en: I'm the Grand Duke's Consort Candidate, However, I Believe I Can Certainly Surpass It!

description.en:
The poor daughter of the Marquis, Teresse, who has been striving to save money day and night, was suddenly informed that she will be one of the "Grand Duke's Consort Candidates." "Being a poor aristocrat such as myself, becoming a consort candidate is impossible for me"– is how I should kindly refuse, but...
  
"Every candidate will be granted 100,000 peir."
"Possible employment as a court lady or lady attendant."
"These generous conditions?!"

"I can be a court lady that I've always longed for!" Teresse thought. And with this in mind, she decided to head to the palace as a "Consort Candidate." However, what awaits her in the palace is a war with self-indulgent young ladies and other consort candidates! Will Teresse be appointed as a court lady or will she stand out from the rest as the Grand Duke's Consort!?
description.ja: 節約好きの侯爵令嬢テレーゼに大公のお妃候補へと声がかかる。だが、貧乏貴族のテレーゼは「憧れの女官」になれるかも！とお城に向かうが、そこで待っていたのはわがままな令嬢達とのお妃争奪戦だった！？

title.ja-ro: Haitoku Onee-san no Yuuwaku ni Kimi wa Kateru ka?

altTitles.en: Can You Resist The Temptations Of An Immoral Oneesan?

altTitles.ja: 背徳お姉さんの誘惑に君は勝てるか？

description.en:
"Come on, Taa-kun... How about we give you a real college debut?"

Taiyo is ready to chase his dreams after becoming a freshman at a prestigious arts college, until he meets Miharu... a beautiful, yet hopelessly chaotic oneesan. Drawn to Taiyo's earnest, straight-laced personality, she embarks on a relentless campaign of flirty temptations. Can Taiyo resist her playful seductions, or will his willpower crumble?

Brace yourself for a delightfully scandalous, everyday rom-com!

altTitles.ja: 嘘喰い

altTitles.en: Usogui

description.en: There are gamblers out there who even bet their lives as ante. But to secure the integrity of these life-threatening gambles, a violent and powerful organization by the name of “Kakerou” referees these games as a neutral party. Follow Madarame Baku AKA Usogui (The Lie Eater) as he gambles against maniacal opponents at games – such as Escape the Abandoned Building, Old Maid, and Hangman – to ultimately “out-gamble” and control the neutral organization of Kakerou itself.
description.fr:
Certains joueurs vont jusqu’à miser leur propre vie. Pour garantir l’intégrité de ces paris mortels, une puissante organisation nommée « Kakerou » arbitre les jeux en tant que partie neutre. Suivez Baku Madarame, alias Usogui (Le Dévoreur de Mensonges), qui affronte des adversaires fous dans des jeux comme « S’échapper du Bâtiment Abandonné », « Le Pouilleux » ou « Le Pendu », dans le but ultime de prendre le contrôle de Kakerou.

description.ja: 「嘘喰い」と呼ばれる謎のギャンブラー斑目貘。ひと癖もふた癖もある仲間達と共に並外れた頭脳と冷徹さで瞬く間に大金を手に入れていくが、その目的は何なのか!?　そして謎の組織「賭郎」とは……!? 　智略と暴力が、嘘と真実が入り混じる賭博の世界――。最強のギャンブラー・斑目貘が、相手の嘘を喰い尽くす!!
description.ru:
Есть игроки, которые ставят на кон свою жизнь. Чтобы сохранить целостность таких смертельно-опасных игр, жестокая и могущественная организация «Кагэро» судит их, как нейтральная сторона.
Наш герой — Баку Мадарамэ, «Пожиратель лжи». Игрок, чья цель — переиграть и в конце взять под контроль саму нейтральную организацию «Кагэро».

---

(Source: [readmanga](https://mintmanga.live/pojiratel_lji))
description.es-la: Hay jugadores que incluso apuestan su vida como apuesta. Pero para asegurar la integridad de estas apuestas que ponen en peligro la vida, una violenta y poderosa organización llamada "Kakerou" arbitra estos juegos como parte neutral. Sigue a Baku Madarame, también conocido como Usogui (El Devorador de Mentiras), mientras se enfrenta a oponentes maníacos en juegos como "Escapar del Edificio Abandonado", "La Vieja Doncella" y "El Ahorcado", para acabar jugando más que la propia organización neutral de Kakerou

altTitles.ja: 無力聖女と無能王女～魔力ゼロで召喚された聖女の異世界救国記～

altTitles.en: The Helpless Saint and the Powerless Princess: The Tale of How a Saint with No Magic Was Summoned to Save Another World

altTitles.pt-br: A Santa Sem Magia e a Princesa Sem Poder

description.en:
One day, listless part-timer Tamura Nana was summoned out of her room and into another world, after which her summoners declared her a saint and asked her to save their world. However, though she was hailed as a saint, it turned out that Nana possessed no magical power at all! To make matters worse, she was chosen as a partner by a princess who can't cast spells...

The helpless saint who has no magic and the powerless princess who can't use magic. And so begins the adventure of these two leftover heroes!
description.ja: ある日自室から異世界に召喚されたフリーターの田村七夕は、突然聖女として国を救ってほしいと頼まれる。しかし、聖女として呼ばれたはずなのに七夕の魔力はゼロ。おまけに魔法が使えない落ちこぼれの王女様のパートナーになることになってしまい…。
description.pt-br:
Um dia, a funcionária de meio-período Tamura Nana foi invocada de seu quarto para outro mundo, onde, de repente, as pessoas daquele lugar pediram que ela se tornasse uma santa e salvasse o reino.
No entanto, embora tivesse sido chamada para ser a santa, Nana logo descobriu que não tinha nenhum poder mágico. E, para piorar, acabou sendo escolhida como parceira de uma princesa que não consegue usar magia...

A santa sem magia e a princesa sem poder. A aventura de duas heroínas rejeitadas começa!

title.ja-ro: Ai no Senbiki ~Mamakatsu Shitara Mama ga Dekita Hanashi~

altTitles.ja: アイノセンビキ～ママ活したらママができた話～

description.en: The protagonist ​​is a middle school boy named Hikawa Jun who lost his mother at birth. He glares at his classmates who complain about their own overprotective mothers and wonders what it would be like if he had a mother of his own. The story begins when Jun, who wants the warmth of a mother, lies about his age and matches up with a stranger on a sugar mama dating app.
description.ja:
その愛情に、境界線はあるのだろうか――

母性を求めた先に出会ったのは、不思議な女性（ママ）でした――。愛に飢えた血の繋がらない男女が築く、歪な親子物語、開幕。
description.es-la: La historia de cómo conseguí una mamá con una Sugar Mommy, Jun Hikawa, es un chico de secundaria que perdió a su madre al nacer. Mientras miraba con enojo a sus compañeros que se quejaban de sus madres sobreprotectoras, Jun soñaba con cómo sería tener una madre. La historia comienza cuando Jun, en su búsqueda del calor maternal, miente sobre su edad y se conecta con una mujer desconocida en una aplicación de Sugar mommy.

description.en:
"We'll kill all vampires. Sharing our own fallen 『 blood 』 as a weapon...!!"

Arbitration Knights travel around the world to protect peace. Rinslet, a girl who has just become a regular knight, meets Yuri, a vampire girl with cool silver hair and crimson eyes. 
Rinslet learns that she is an abomination who kills her own kind by manipulating the power of 《 blood armor 》, which materializes blood into swords, bows and arrows. She becomes Yuri's kin in exchange for her life, and her goal is...?

A Yuri x Vampire x Dark Fantasy!

description.en:
A stalker? A pervert?   
No, no. I'm just a college boy who is single-mindedly in love with someone.  
It's just. I live my life wearing a paper bag on my head.   
People look at me strangely on campus.  
  
Even though he's extremely timid, he abruptly confessed his love and pushing forward!  
The girl he confessed to, Umi-chan, took it by surprise! And soon an unexpected turn of events is about to happen…?!  
A series of weird but lovely, super cute romantic comedy
description.pt:
Um perseguidor? Um pervertido?  
Não não. Sou apenas um universitário que está totalmente apaixonado por alguém.  
É apenas. Vivo minha vida com um saco de papel na cabeça.  
As pessoas olham para mim de forma estranha no campus.  
  
Mesmo sendo extremamente tímido, ele abruptamente confessou seu amor e seguiu em frente!  
A garota para quem ele se confessou, Umi-chan, pegou de surpresa! E logo uma mudança inesperada de eventos está para acontecer… ?!  
Uma série de comédia romântica esquisita, mas adorável e super fofa

description.en:
The strongest final boss in RPG history figures out a way to get super rich in his own world! Demon Lord Menas, ruler of the Noa Empire, finds the Resistance's forces on his doorstep. While Alex, a determined, beautiful, blonde young lady stands before him, he gets this weird feeling of deja vu... Isn't this just like the prologue of 'ResNoa', the video game he plays in his dreams?! Menas realizes that he was the final boss of his own world all along! He fakes his death at the hands of Alex and seizes his chance at a brand new life with both hands. Our dark hero takes his world by storm, using whatever cheat codes he has to protect his newfound freedom!
___
**Character Designer:** [Tajima Ryuushi](https://mangadex.org/author/3ac15f57-6a12-4018-b549-30aab86fc6c8)
description.ja: RPG史上最強のラスボス、自分の世界（ゲーム）の攻略法を知る。ノア帝国の皇帝――魔帝メナスは、ある日革命軍に城を襲撃される。果敢に向かってくる美しい金髪の少女・アレクを前に、謎の既視感を覚えるメナス……それはまさしく、時折見る夢の中でやり込んでいたRPGゲーム、『レジスタンス・ノア』のプロローグ映像そっくりで――。自分がこの世界のラスボスだと理解したメナスは、勇者に殺されたふりをして第二の人生を謳歌しようと決意する――…！！

description.en:
"With your power now, no one can defeat you – Even the Gods guarantee it!"

Elk Kinesis, the protagonist, was born as the eldest son of a prestigious duke’s family. However, due to his weak and seemingly useless skill, "Telekinesis", he was ridiculed and looked down upon by those around him. One fateful day, he was betrayed by his own father and half-siblings. In front of the only person who truly cared for him—his maid, Emma—he was brutally killed.

When he awoke, he found himself before the goddess Pipina. Despite being offered a powerful skill, Elk refused. Instead, he wished to grow stronger using nothing but "Telekinesis". Moved by his determination, Pipina subjected him to an unimaginable 2,000 years of training.

After centuries of grueling effort, Elk was finally sent back to the mortal world by the goddess. Reuniting with Emma, he now sets out on his ultimate goal—to take revenge on the Kinesis family that betrayed him!
description.ja: 「今の君なら誰にも負けないよ　神様が保証する」――史上最弱のスキル《念動力》を授かった主人公エルク・キネーシス。公爵家の長男として生まれながら、弱小スキルゆえに周りからは見下されていた。ある日、父とその異母兄妹におとしめられ、唯一の理解者であるメイドのエマの目の前で、エルクは無惨にも殺されてしまう。目を覚ますとそこにあらわれたのは、女神・ピピーナ。特別なスキルを求めず、《念動力》だけで強くなりたいという彼の願いに感銘を受けたピピーナは、2000年に及ぶ特訓をほどこすことに。長きに渡る修行の末、女神の計らいで現世に戻った彼はエマと再会し、かつて自分を虐げたキネーシス家へと復讐を誓う！

description.en:
Rokuro Enmado is from a family of exorcists who remove evil Kegare, but his real dream is to be a singer, a soccer player, or anything other than an exorcist. When another exorcist, a girl named Benio Adashino arrives, Rokura is suddenly inflamed with competitive spirit and decides to put his natural knack to good use. Their rivalry gets more complicated when they both learn they are the destined "Twin Star Exorcists," two ultimate fighters fated to marry and create the prophesied child who will eliminate all the Kegare in the world.


---

description.ru: С давних времён доблестные оммёдзи сражаются со скверной - злобными духами, рождёнными из человеческих страхов, боли и отчаяния. Рокуро с детства мечтал стать сильнейшим оммёдзи и очистить мир от скверны, но ужасная трагедия на долгие годы убила в нём всякое желание бороться. Но кому есть дело до желаний гиперактивного мальчишки, когда от него и талантливой девочки зависит судьба всего мира?
description.tr: Rokuro Enmado, kötü Kegare'yi ortadan kaldıran bir şeytan kovucu ailesindendir, ancak asıl hayali bir şarkıcı, futbolcu ya da şeytan kovucudan başka bir şey olmaktır. Benio Adashino adında başka bir şeytan çıkarıcı kız geldiğinde, Rokura aniden rekabetçi bir ruhla alevlenir ve doğal yeteneğini iyi bir şekilde kullanmaya karar verir. İkisi de kaderlerinde evlenip dünyadaki tüm Kegare'leri ortadan kaldıracak kehanet çocuğunu yaratmak olan iki nihai savaşçı, "İkiz Yıldız Şeytan Kovucu" olduklarını öğrendiklerinde rekabetleri daha da karmaşık bir hal alır.

Os dois são apelidados de "Exorcistas das Estrelas Gêmeas" e descobrem que estão destinados a se casar... Rokuro pode escapar de ambos os destinos? Quando o melhor amigo de Rokuro, Ryogo, desaparece, Rokuro é forçado a pedir ajuda a Benio para entrar em Magano, o reino dos Kegare, para resgatá-lo!

description.en:
Wakaba Yoshizawa has a childhood friend named Komaki Umezono.

This girl wore the mask of an honor student with good morals who's blessed with both beauty and brains, but in reality she's an evil genius who looked down on people. For the sake of regaining the dignity she lost to Komaki, Wakaba challenges her to a match, but Komaki tells her "Each time I win, I will take one precious thing from you." as a condition!? Every time she loses to the girl she "hates", her true feelings get exposed.

(Source: Young Ace Up)
description.fr:
Komaki Umezono est l'amie d'enfance de Wakaba Yoshizawa.

Cette Komaki apparait comme une élève modèle, dotée d'une belle moralité, d'une grande beauté et d'une intelligence hors du commun, mais en réalité, c'est une fille d'une grande curauté qui méprisait les autres. Afin de recouvrer la dignité qu’elle a perdue face à Komaki, Wakaba la défie dans un duel, mais Komaki lui impose une condition : « Désormais, si tu perds, je te prendrais tout ce à quoi tu tiens, petit à petit. » Dès lors qu’elle perd contre la fille qu’elle « déteste », ses véritables sentiments sont mis à nu.
description.ja:
「嫌い」な彼女に負けるたび、曝け出されるホントの気持ち――。

吉沢わかばの幼馴染、梅園小牧。彼女は、品行方正で才色兼備な優等生の仮面を被った、人を見下す性悪女だった。そんな小牧に奪われた尊厳を取り戻すため、彼女に勝負を挑むわかばだったが、「私が勝ったらわかばの大事なものを一つずつ奪う」という条件をつけられて――!?ファーストキスに始まり、一つ一つ「尊厳」を奪われていく中で、小牧に抱く気持ちが「嫌い」だけでないことに気付きーー？

Wakaba Yoshizawa, Komaki Umezono adlı bir çocukluk arkadaşına sahip.

Bu kız hem güzellik hem de zeka ile kutsanmış iyi ahlaklı bir onur öğrencisi maskesi takıyor ama aslında insanlara yukarıdan bakan kötü bir dâhi. description.es-la:
¡Una distorsionada historia de amor entre la estudiante modelo con una máscara demoníaca y la chica común que no se rinde!

Wakaba Yoshizawa, la amiga de la infancia de Wakaba, Komaizumi Komaki. Ella era una chica malvada que llevaba una máscara de estudiante modelo perfecta y talentosa, que miraba por encima del hombro a los demás. Wakaba desafía a Komaki para recuperar su dignidad que le fue arrebatada, pero se le pone una condición: "Si gano, tomaré una cosa importante de Wakaba una por una" ¡Cada vez que pierde contra ella, revela sus verdaderos sentimientos! ¡Una emocionante historia de amor entre chicas que ganó el Premio de Oro en el 28vo Concurso Sneaker Award, ahora en formato de cómic!
description.pt-br:
Uma história de amor distorcida entre garotas: uma garota diabólica escondida por trás da máscara de uma estudante exemplar x uma garota comum que odeia perder.

Wakaba Yoshizawa tem uma amiga de infância chamada Komaki Umezono.

Essa garota usava a máscara de uma estudante exemplar com boas virtudes, abençoada com beleza e inteligência, mas na realidade ela é uma gênio do mal que despreza as pessoas. Para recuperar a dignidade perdida para Komaki, Wakaba desafia-a para um duelo, mas Komaki lhe diz: "Cada vez que eu ganhar, vou tirar algo precioso de você." como condição!? Cada vez que ela perde para a garota que "odeia", seus verdadeiros sentimentos são expostos.

Yotsuya Yuusuke along with his classmates Shindou Iu and Hakozaki Kusue have been transported to a strange and unknown world inhabited by mythological creatures. As soon as they arrive, they meet somebody calling himself the Game Master who then grants them a time-limited quest. To aid them in this quest, he also bestows Shindou and Hakozaki with the roles of a Magician and a Warrior while Yotsuya is randomly granted the role of... a Farmer?!

description.en:
“Onii-san, congratulations on your marriage. This person is your bride.”

“M-my name is Watanae Yuuka… I’m in the same class as you…”

My name is Sakata Yuuichi. I’m in my 2nd year of high school. Due to my parents’ circumstances, I’m suddenly getting married..? Furthermore, my partner is a plain girl, Watanae-san. During my 3rd year of middle school, I went through a bad experience. Ever since then, I’ve only been interested in 2D heroines. There’s absolutely no way I’d ever be interested in a 3D girl. That was what I thought, but…

“…Well then, who’s your favorite heroine right now?”

Turns out, she was actually an otaku and she becomes very talkative when you get to know her. She’d always happily engage in our conversations. She showed me things I’d never have expected from a girl in my class.

“Err, since we’re going to be living together… Is it okay if I call you Yuu-kun?”

And, the moment I let my guard down, she’d instantly try to shorten the distance between us. What’s more…

“Just between you and me, I’m actually the voice actress for Yuuna Izumi from 『Alice Stage』. Thank you for always supporting me!”

It’s a secret from everyone else, but it turns out she’s actually my favorite heroine’s voice actress?! I am only interested in 2D heroines! But, Yuuka’s true self, which she only shows when she’s alone with me, is nothing but cute! This is the story of me and Yuuka, starting as bethrothed. A heartwarming and chaotic romcom!

42 year old "shachiku" (company slave) Matsuda Takeshi gets worked to death, as is customary in Japan. His one dying wish is to work for a decent enterprise, not the black company he had been working for. His wish is heard by a god who, for his own amusement, has him reincarnate as a young elf male in another world, with increased affinity for earth magic and ability to command golems. The new golem master sets out on a quest to acquire the Seven Treasures left behind by a legendary mage from 1000 years ago.

description.en:
"Onii-tama?"

Cain, who reincarnated as one of the love interests of an otome game, screamed at the loveliness of his sister, Diana. I can't believe that this angel is going to be a villainess with countless bad ends-- No, there is no way that such a future can exist! Clenching his fist tightly, he raises his sister into a gentle lady, while also dispelling the darkness held by the love interests in place of the heroine. Relying on his game knowledge from his previous life and an orphaned chamberlain. Everything for his beloved sister--
description.id:
"Abwang?"

Cain, orang yang baru saja bereinkarnasi menjadi salah satu target kencan di sebuah otome game, tiba-tiba berteriak karena melihat keimutan adik perempuannya, Diana.
Aku tidak menyangka kalau malaikat kecil ini akan menjadi seorang villainess dengan akhir yang tragis-- Tidak, aku tidak akan membiarkan masa depan seperti itu terjadi!
Dengan mengepalkan tangannya, dia bertekat untuk membesarkan adik perempuannya menjadi seorang wanita yang baik hati dan tidak sombong, sembari menghilangkan segala masa lalu yang buruk dari para target kencan lain menggantikan sang tokoh utama.
Bergantung pada pengetahuannya tentang gamenya di kehidupan yang dulu dan juga pengalamannya sebagai anak yatim piastu, semuanya dilakukan demi adik perempuannya-- dan akhirnya, tantangan bagi sang kakak akan dimulai sekarang!

description.en:
[The Eternal Scattering Flowers: Fiore Caduto Eterna] is a game ill-suited of being known as a galge, as the main heroine would – regardless of the chosen route – meet her demise.

Fudou Niito, a resident of Japan, went to bed dissatisfied with the ending of the game. When he next awoke, he found himself in the body of the game’s hated fake saint, Elrise. Confused, but with an understanding that Elrise’s actions would spell disaster for many lives in the future, he took advantage of the situation and acted to change the course of history.

As a result, despite her rotten personality, Elrise was adored by those around her as a perfect saint. Furthermore, the game itself was intrinsically linked to his original world and changed accordingly to suit Elrise’s actions. Without any knowledge of what the hell was going on, the fake saint Elrise continued to alter her fate. A saint on the outside, but a man on the inside.

The transmigrator was a piece of shit and the person he transmigrated into was also a piece of shit. A combination of shit and shit would cause an accident – to create the greatest fake saint shitshow of the year!
description.id:
[The Eternal Scattering Flowers: Fiore Caduto Eterna] adalah sebuah permainan yang tidak cocok untuk di panggil sebagai galge, karena apapun rute yang di pilih heroine utama akan selalu menemui ajalnya.

Fudou Niito, seorang penduduk di jepang, pergi tidur dengan ketidakpuasan pada akhir dari gamenya. Selanjutnya ketika dia terbangun, ia menemukan dirinya berada dalam tubuh seorang saint yang di benci dalam game, Elrise.

Dia kebingungan, namun dengan pemahaman bahwa tindakan Elrise akan menyebabkan bencana untuk banyak kehidupan di masa depan, dia memanfaatkan situasi itu dan bertindak untuk mengubah jalannya sejarah.

Sebagai hasilnya, terlepas dari kepribadian busuknya, Elrise di cintai oleh orang-orang di sekitarnya sebagai seorang saint yang sempurna. Terlebih lagi, game itu sendiri pada intinya terhubung dengan dunia asli tempatnya berada dan berubah berdasarkan tindakan Elrise. Tanpa mengetahui apa yang sedang terjadi, seorang saint palsu Elrise terus-menerus mengubah takdirnya.

Seorang saint di luar, namun pria di dalamnya.

Orang yang merasuki adalah seorang bajingan dan orang yang di rasukinya juga merupakan seorang bajingan. Kombinasi dari para bajingan akan menyebabkan mala petaka yang akan menciptakan pertunjukan saint palsu bajingan terbesar tahun ini!

description.en:
"Um… Mikami-san?"

"Don’t mind me."

"Aren’t you a little too close?"

"Don’t mind me♪"

Kirishima Rei, a self-proclaimed introverted loner, had completely failed his attempt at a high school debut. One day, by sheer chance, he ended up saving the school’s most talked-about beauty, Mikami Hina, from a tough situation. In return, she insisted on repaying the favor by having lunch together.

But Mikami-san was clearly someone from a world far beyond his reach. This brief connection—once she had properly thanked him—was sure to fade away. Or at least, that’s what Rei had assumed.

Yet, before he knew it…

Secret lunchtime meetings, whispered conversations after school, bumping into each other on the way to class, unexpected encounters on weekends—his time spent with Mikami-san kept increasing.

No matter how much he tried to keep his distance, she would just brush it off with a cheerful "Don’t mind me♪" and push her way deeper into his daily life.

An easygoing, kindhearted boy × a mysterious, assertive beauty—
A love comedy where the heroine invades the protagonist’s world!?
description.pl:
„Um… Mikami-san?”

„Nie przejmuj się mną”.

„Nie jesteś trochę za blisko?”

„Nie przejmuj się mną♪”

Kirishima Rei, samozwańczy introwertyczny samotnik, totalnie zawalił swoją próbę debiutu w liceum. Pewnego dnia, zupełnie przypadkowo, uratował najczęściej-omawianą piękność w szkole, Mikami Hinę. W zamian za to ona nalegała, żeby mu się odwdzięczyć wspólnym lunchem.

Ale Mikami-san była wyraźnie kimś z zupełnie innego świata, daleko poza jego zasięgiem. Ta krótka więź – po tym, jak odpowiednio mu podziękowała – z pewnością zniknęłaby. A przynajmniej tak zakładał Rei.

Jednak zanim się zorientował...

Tajne spotkania w porze lunchu, szeptane rozmowy po szkole, przypadkowe spotkania w drodze na zajęcia, nieoczekiwane spotkania w weekendy – czas spędzany z Mikami-san stawał się coraz dłuższy.

Nieważne, jak bardzo starał się zachować dystans, ona po prostu zbywała to radosnym „Nie przejmuj się mną♪” i coraz bardziej wkraczała w jego codzienne życie.

Beztroski, dobroduszny chłopak × tajemnicza, asertywna piękność —
Komedia romantyczna, w której bohaterka inwazyjnie wchodzi w świat głównego bohatera!?

description.en:
Who knew that even a stationary plant could be surprisingly capable?!

Our protagonist is a saint, or was, until she was betrayed by one of her fellow saint apprentices as well as her fiancé, a hero. In her final moments, she recalls her previous life, when she was just a normal Japanese high school girl, but that doesn't help the fact that she's being eaten alive by a massive plant monster. And yet, by a stroke of luck, she doesn't die for good, but instead reincarnates as said plant monster. With the upper half of a human and the lower half of a plant, she must now spend her life as an Alraune.

And so, she tries to live the peaceful life of a plant, photosynthesizing all day!
Welcome to the diary of a plant girl who just wants some peace and quiet, but something always gets in her way!

description.en:
"Why is my favorite singer singing my song!?"

Tsunagu Kurose, a high school student with a passion for musics composing but a terrible singing voice, often receives criticisms whenever he posts them on the Internet. One day, while shouldering the responsibility of taking commemorative photos of the culture festival reluctantly with Otoha Hinomori - a quiet classmate sitting next to him, his childhood friend Tetsu Tamura was in a dilemma because of unavoidable accidents occuring on the stage run by his club. Without hesitation, Tsunagu gives him the demo instrumental songs he composed to save the situation. Unfortunately, Tetsu open the wrong music file with Tsunagu's terrible lyrics, making him feels like he wanna hole up due to that unfortunate disaster. In despair at this miserable situation, Otoha takes off her thick glasses, tightly grips the microphone and hums that song! 

"Isn't this voice similar to icy - the singer I've always admired...!?"

*Source: Takeshobo, translated*
description.ja:
「どうして俺の曲を、憧れの歌い手が歌ってるんだ！？」

高校生・黒瀬繋玖（くろせつなぐ）は、歌唱は微妙だが作曲してネットに投稿するのが趣味。ある日隣の席の陰キャ女子・氷ノ守音羽（ひのもりおとは）と学園祭の写真係になる。当日友人のピンチに自分の楽曲を提供するが、流れたのは聴くに堪えないデモテープバージョン。悲惨な状況に絶望したそのとき、マイクを手に歌唱したのは地味眼鏡を外した音羽だった！その歌声は憧れの推し歌い手icyそのもので・・・！？
description.vi:
"Tại sao bài hát của mình, lại được ca sĩ mình yêu thích hát vậy chứ!?"

Tsunagu Kurose, nam sinh cấp ba với niềm đam mê sáng tác nhạc cùng giọng hát dở tệ, thường nhận phải gạch đá khi đăng tải chúng lên mạng. Một ngày nọ, trong lúc đang gánh vác công việc chụp những bức hình kỉ niệm ngày hội văn hóa bất đắc dĩ cùng cô bạn trầm tính bàn bên Otoha Hinomori, cậu bạn thưở nhỏ Tetsu Tamura đã rơi vào tình cảnh tiến thoái lưỡng nan vì một vài sự cố bất khả kháng diễn ra ngay trên sân khấu do CLB cậu điều hành. Không do dự, Tsunagu đã đưa cho cậu dùng bản demo không lời của bài nhạc sáng tác ra để cứu vãn tình hình, nhưng trớ trêu thay Tetsu lại mở nhầm file nhạc có lời hát tệ hại của Tsunagu khiến cho cậu như muốn chui tọt xuống đất vì thảm họa oái oăm đấy. Ngay lúc tuyệt vọng nhất, Otoha gỡ bỏ chiếc kính dày cộm của mình, nắm chặt chiếc micro ngân nga khúc ca ấy!

Và rằng "Giọng hát ấy chẳng phải giống với ca sĩ mà mình vẫn luôn mến mộ - icy hay sao...!?

description.en:
"Kukuku... He is the weakest of the Four Heavenly Kings."...But he isn't, he's actually the strongest!? The archenemy of the Human World, the Demon Continent.

Ralph is the weakest of the three. But, the other three, Freya, Lilia, and Lushika actually have a secret. "We don't want to fight at all!!" They completely delegated all the fighting to Ralph! They have zero combat experience! They're scaredy-cats and girls who only act tough when outside! These insanely lazy girls absolutely refuse to fight. Meanwhile, Ralph has been so stressed being pushed around and having to fight constant battles. He tries hard to escape from this black company-like atmosphere, but...

"Enough already, just fight!"
"I don't want to, though?"
"You're too much!!"
"...(Faints)"

「ククク…ヤツは四天王の中では最弱」

「「「戦うなんて絶対イヤじゃ！」」」

彼女たちは、戦闘経験皆無な超絶ビビりの内弁慶ガールズだったのだ！やりたい放題＆サボり万歳！圧倒的怠惰な生活を送る彼女たちは戦いを断固反対！一方で、振り回されっぱなし＆勤続疲労が限界に近いラルフ。彼はこの状況を打破すべくあの手この手で、彼女たちの自立を促すのだが――。

Gifted with the unique skill "Hermit," granted only to those forsaken by divine prophecy, and supported by his most trusted allies, he begins a covert revolution. description.en:
A middle-aged man goes to the mountain to commit suicide. On the way he finds a sealed youkai black fox girl in a small cave. She asks him to free her, and he does it without a second thought and goes on to die, but the fox girl, despite her original intentions, forces the man to give up and they eventually marry.  
This is about their married life.
description.fr:
Un homme d’âge moyen se rend dans une montagne pour se suicider. Sur le chemin, il tombe nez à nez avec une démone renard scellée. Elle lui demande de l’aider, ce qu’il fait sans hésiter avant de partir mourir, mais la démone l’arrête et finit, suite à certains événements, par se marier avec lui. Ceci est l’histoire de leur vie de couple.

description.pt-br: Um homem de meia idade escala uma montanha para cometer suicídio. No caminho ele encontra uma Raposa Youkai selada em uma pequena caverna. Ela pede para o viajante salvá-la, e ele o faz sem nem pensar duas vezes e retorna em sua caminhada para a morte, porém a Youkai, apesar de suas intenções iniciais, força o homem a desistir e eles eventualmente acabam se casando. Essa história é sobre a sua vinda juntos.

description.en: College student Souji Miyamoto ends up getting transported to another world after test-cutting with a replica sword he bought on impulse. Because he arrives right in the middle of a hero-summoning ritual in a certain kingdom, Souji is mistaken for the Hero. By a strange turn of events, the princess discovers that he's actually a fake. Holding the fact over him that if others find out he's an impostor he’ll be executed, Souji is forced to set out on a journey to defeat the Demon King. However, every member of the Hero’s party turns out to be seriously eccentric—each with their own complications...!?
description.ja: 普通の大学生宮本総司はある日ネットショッピングで誤って模造刀を購入してしまう。 届いた刀を一振りしてみると、なぜか異世界へワープし、勇者として召喚されてしまった。 なんとか現代に帰りたい総司は再び刀を振ると、今度は王女エリカの自室へとワープしてしまう。 エリカに本当の勇者ではないことがバレてしまった総司は、もし偽物だと王に知れ渡った場合死刑になると脅され、強制的に勇者として魔王討伐の冒険へと旅立つことに。 しかもそのメンバーは癖があるやつばかりで――！？

description.en:
In another world where the Royal family power is on decline, and turmoil are lasting.  
  
In a remote village, a young child, who will later be named Ars, is "gardening" and "improving the land." Having the memories of his previous life, he who was fond of "city building" games, initiated to do "selective breeding for crops" and "house constructions" with his own magic to get out of poverty, and finally acquired a "brick creation!" Selling his bricks to a peddler, he obtains a rare egg of a "tamed beast," but can he raise it safely?
description.ja: 王家が衰退し動乱の続く異世界。とある寒村で、後にアルスと呼ばれることになる幼児は“土いじり”――“畑の土壌改良”をしていた。「街作り」ゲームに熱中した前世の記憶があった彼は、貧乏脱却のため自作魔法で“野菜の品種改良”や“家屋の建築”を開始し、ついに「レンガ生成」を習得する！行商人にレンガを売りさばく中で希少な“使役獣の卵”を手に入れるが、無事に孵化させることができるのか＿＿？
